problem: The active response indicator used a trailing spacer, anchoring its dots and agent label to the leading message edge.
solution: The dots and agent label now form one full-width row centered relative to the shared chat column while remaining inside normal message flow.
lesson: Transient status UI should align to the content column that owns it. Centering the complete status group avoids visual drift from labels with different lengths and remains correct when a history sidebar is present.
